---
# ocp4_workload_guild_seats: one project per workshop seat, then the seat's RoleBindings

- name: Create a project for every seat
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    definition:
      apiVersion: v1
      kind: Namespace
      metadata:
        name: "{{ item }}-{{ guid }}"
  loop: "{{ guild_seats_users }}"

- name: Grant every seat its roles
  ansible.builtin.include_tasks: seat_access.yml
  loop: "{{ guild_seats_users }}"

---
# seat_access.yml: bind one seat's user to every role in guild_seats_roles

- name: Bind the seat user to its roles
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    definition:
      apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
      kind: RoleBinding
      metadata:
        name: "seat-{{ item }}"
        namespace: "{{ item }}-{{ guid }}"
      roleRef:
        apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
        kind: ClusterRole
        name: "{{ item }}"
      subjects:
        - apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
          kind: User
          name: "{{ item }}"
  loop: "{{ guild_seats_roles }}"

answer:
Each RoleBinding was sent to a project named after a role, not a seat: the API answered 404 for namespaces "edit-t6bvz" and "view-t6bvz", which do not exist and never will.

The seat projects were created. The first task reported changed for guild-user1, guild-user2 and guild-user3, so guild-user1-t6bvz, guild-user2-t6bvz and guild-user3-t6bvz exist. It is not a timing problem, and a pause or retries would only repeat the same 404.

What went wrong is a loop-variable collision. ansible/roles_ocp_workloads/ocp4_workload_guild_seats/tasks/main.yml loops over guild_seats_users and includes seat_access.yml once per seat with the loop variable item. seat_access.yml then loops over guild_seats_roles, also with item, and the inner loop's item shadows the outer one; Ansible warns "The loop variable 'item' is already in use". Inside the inner loop item is the role (edit, view), so the namespace, the subject and the binding name are all built from the role. The line that puts the RoleBinding in the wrong project is agnosticd/agnosticd-v2:ansible/roles_ocp_workloads/ocp4_workload_guild_seats/tasks/seat_access.yml:12 (namespace: "{{ item }}-{{ guid }}").

Fix: give the outer loop its own variable, e.g. loop_control: loop_var: seat_user on the include in main.yml, and use seat_user for the namespace and the subject in seat_access.yml (or set loop_var on the inner loop and use that name for the role).
